g.text: This is a simplified new customer order process. Details of payment gateway and tax
integrations have been intentionaly excluded for clarity. In this diagram the
'Prospect' is your potential customer browsing at your website or portal. 'Portal' is
your web site or application running on your server(s) where prospects or your sales
team can sign up for your services and products.
How would you like to pay?
Individual details are ommitted here for clarity as are details on managing failed payments.
Send email confirming order, include $0 balance Invoice PDF as receipt
Send email confirming order, include Invoice PDF for payment
